notes.title: Resolution scaling, ammo autoloading and more...
notes.content:
I finally fixed some bugs YAY!

Support for diffrent resolutions and aspect ratios
You can now hold F to autoload ammo!
Added a crosshair
Intro "dream" sequence has a pause menu
Inverted Y axis option
Błędy ortograficzne ;)

Thanks for playing the game and all positive reviews <3
